# ECN-2026-008 - Change notice - Machining CNC turning center #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-CN03

## Reason for change
Field inspection and recent preventive maintenance review identified inconsistent chuck jaw retention readings on EQ-P1-L3-CN03. To mitigate recurring slippage and improve repeatability of part setup, the chuck jaw bolt torque specification is being standardized and documented for all operations on this machine. This change aligns the equipment control parameter with documented best practice in SB-1014 and clarifies execution steps referenced in SOP-P1-L3-02 and SOP-P1-L3-03.

## Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-CN03 (Machining CNC turning center #3)  
- Process documentation: SOP-P1-L3-02, SOP-P1-L3-03 (updates required to reflect torque value)  
- Maintenance work instructions and torque audit checklist used for EQ-P1-L3-CN03

## Implementation
- Add the following mandatory torque specification to the machine setup and maintenance sections for EQ-P1-L3-CN03: The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m.  
- Update SOP-P1-L3-02 and SOP-P1-L3-03 to include verification of the specified torque during initial setup and maintenance tasks. Cross-reference SB-1014 for inspection criteria and failure modes.  
- Maintenance personnel will use a calibrated torque wrench capable of confirming the specified value. Record verification in the existing maintenance log for EQ-P1-L3-CN03. Any deviation from the specified torque must be documented and escalated per SB-1014.  
- Training: Issue a brief update notice to affected operators and maintainers with a single-line change summary referencing SOP-P1-L3-02 and SOP-P1-L3-03.

## Approvals
- Engineering approval: required prior to release of updated SOPs (see SB-1014 for approval workflow)  
- Maintenance manager approval: required to implement and verify torque records on EQ-P1-L3-CN03  
- Operations lead sign-off: required to confirm training and incorporation into shift handover procedure

Related documents: SB-1014, SOP-P1-L3-02, SOP-P1-L3-03
